This question is a classic one. A pyramid scheme works only if the flow of money is greater than the payout. That is, if money is flowing in at a faster rate than money is flowing out. It will keep working as long as new people keep joining. For a while, at least.
So in theory, it works. It's just that it can't keep working forever. The reason being that eventually the flow of money will slow down. People are going to slow down in joining, and the flow of money will be less than the payout. At that point, the scheme is over. It's over. But in the short-term, it works. It works really well, and people make a ton of money.
